info.title: CriptoNous x402
info.description: CriptoNous x402 — pay-per-query crypto market intelligence API on Solana + Base USDC: on-chain whale flow, smart-money tracking, wallet intelligence, sentiment & narrative pulse, regime/timing, structured oracle signals, multi-source confluence. Machine catalog + MCP + AccessPass + audit receipts. Cheapest probe $0.02 (hermes.pulse). HTTP 402 + idempotent verify. MoonPay PayBox & agent wallets compatible. Manifest /.well-known/x402 · llms.txt. NFA — analysis & context only, never trade execution or custody.
info.x-guidance: Pay-per-query crypto market intelligence on Solana + Base USDC. 1) GET /x402/resource/{sku} returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED. 2) Facilitator: retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (Dexter/PayAI). 3) Templo MCP: POST /x402/mcp/temple_request_tribute {"sku"} then pay USDC + temple_verify + X-PAYMENT. 4) Consume AccessPass via temple_consume_pass. Discovery: /.well-known/x402 · /llms.txt · /x402/hello. NFA — analysis only.
